newsitem.title: INDIA: INDIA COPPER, NICKEL, TIN EXTEND DECLINES.
newsitem.headline: INDIA COPPER, NICKEL, TIN EXTEND DECLINES.

text.p: Copper, nickel and tin prices extended losses on the local market, dealers said.
Other base metals were steady in limited activity.
Copper and nickel prices dropped further on the back of losses in the world market which prompted fresh selling. Sluggish local demand added to the metals woes.
Copper slid by 50 rupees to 13,150 rupees per quintal after losing 125 rupees last week, while nickel prices fell by 300 rupees to 33,800 rupees after losing 200 rupees last week.
Tin dropped 200 rupees to 29,000 rupees on fresh arrivals.
Aluminium was steady at 7,800 rupees per quintal, as was zinc at 8,400 rupees and lead at 4,200. There was nominal trading in these metals and market sentiment remained subdued.
